title: PUDL applet package manifest
description: applet.json, the one file a host reads from an installed applet package. Every file it names is relative to the package folder and inside it.

name.description: The applet's name, which is also its folder's name, its window key and the last part of its page's address.

version.description: The package version, which the host uses as the cache stamp of the applet's files.

license.description: An SPDX identifier, such as Apache-2.0.

icon.description: A small full-colour picture of the applet, such as an SVG of 32 by 32, for the launch menu and the window's title bar.

body.description: An HTML fragment: the mount and any copy around it. Without it the host writes a bare mount.

fit.description: How the applet fits its page, as PUDL's data-applet-fit.

shape.description: The window's first size as fractions of the desktop, "w,h", such as "0.28,0.88".

min.description: The smallest size a reader may give the window, "w,h" in pixels.

handles.description: PUDL's requests the applet answers, as define()'s handles.

instances.description: How many instances requests may open, as define()'s instances.

actions.description: The manifest of the actions the applet publishes.

continuity.description: Whether the host keeps the applet's state across pages, as it does for its own.

needs.description: Host services the applet cannot run without; a host lacking one does not offer the applet.

wants.description: Host services the applet uses when they are there.

shared.description: Folders beside the package that it loads from, such as ../shared, which a collection's build copies alongside it.

bundle.description: Scripts beside the package, in order, that the build writes in front of src, so the installed script is one file and registers its applet as it loads, as PUDL requires. Not in the built manifest.
